name: Schoenoplectus

project_scope.installer_dependency: S. californicus not canonical; installer owns species.

look_here_first: Compare culm cross sections, then dissect ripe spikelets to count perianth bristles.
shared_genus_traits: Rhizomatous wetland sedges with basal sheaths and few leaf blades.
Branched spikelet panicle appearing lateral below a stemlike continuation bract.

species_comparison_matrix.californicus: Bluntly triangular, often nearly round at base.

overlap_cautions: Culm shape varies with height; compare matched mid-culm sections.
Use ripe achenes; do not identify solely by panicle habit.

local_source_pool_lookalikes.separate: Dense cylindrical male and female spike zones, not a sedge spikelet panicle.

diagnostic_photo_checklist: Dissected mature achenes with labeled bristles
Matched basal sheaths and whole panicles
handoff: Diagnostic Photo Polish owns images; Approved Taxa Installer owns S. californicus.
